subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add an official model/session reconcile-reset surface, and should it report only by default or also clear explicit session, agent, auth, and generated catalog pins under scoped flags?
rationale: The remaining work changes how persisted model/auth selections are reported or mutated, and source inspection shows current behavior intentionally preserves explicit pins across reset paths.

options.title: Report-first reconcile with scoped reset
options.body: Add diagnostics first and require explicit flags for each mutation class so users can see shadowing before OpenClaw clears persisted selections.

options.title: Keep current doctor/status surfaces only
options.body: Leave `/model default`, status text, and doctor reporting as the supported recovery path, and close the broader command request as out of scope.

options.title: Automatically reset conflicting selections
options.body: Make config defaults win broadly over session and agent pins, accepting a compatibility break for users who depend on persistent explicit overrides.

recommendation.title: Report-first reconcile with scoped reset
recommendation.body: Add diagnostics first and require explicit flags for each mutation class so users can see shadowing before OpenClaw clears persisted selections.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/compatibility choice across CLI, doctor, session, and provider-routing surfaces, and steipete has the strongest current-main routing signal.
